name: Save a cache
description: Save Cache artifacts like dependencies and build outputs to improve workflow execution time

path.description: A list of files, directories, and wildcard patterns to cache

key.description: An explicit key for saving the cache

upload-chunk-size.description: The chunk size used to split up large files during upload, in bytes

enableCrossOsArchive.description: An optional boolean when enabled, allows windows runners to save caches that can be restored on other platforms
